value.rationale: Tame gonality differs fundamentally from ordinary hyperelliptic gonality in characteristic two. The theorem exactly identifies minimal tame cubic genus-two classes and proves uniqueness and arithmetic Frobenius partition of the reduced branch divisor. This is natural tame Hurwitz data with direct relevance to the low-degree boundary of tame Belyi constructions, beyond the already-known genus-two model census.
